about_short_description.short_description: NewsBlur is a personal news reader that brings people together to talk about the world.

product.name: NewsBlur Personal News Reader
product.description: A platform that aggregates and delivers real-time RSS news stories, allowing users to read and share news content in various formats across web and mobile apps.

product.name: NewsBlur Mobile and Desktop Applications
product.description: Native applications for iOS, macOS, and Android that provide access to NewsBlur's news reading and sharing features with device-optimized interfaces.

product.name: NewsBlur Shared Stories and Blurblog
product.description: A feature that allows users to share news stories publicly or privately, facilitating discussion and social interaction around news content.

identifier.value: NewsBlur Story Tagging and Saved Searches

product.name: NewsBlur Story Tagging and Saved Searches
product.description: Tools for organizing and quickly accessing news stories using custom tags and saved search queries.

product.name: NewsBlur Real-Time RSS Feed Delivery
product.description: A service that pushes RSS news stories to users instantly as they are published, ensuring timely access to news content.

identifier.value: NewsBlur YouTube Subscription Backfill and Integration

product.name: NewsBlur YouTube Subscription Backfill and Integration
product.description: A feature that allows users to follow YouTube channels and access their video content within NewsBlur, including search and sharing capabilities.
